name: Dev flow
description: The development flow for any stack: one worktree per agent, the checks each change needs, a close that lists what is still owed, handoff notes, debts and decision records. Your project binds it to its own commands in .picode.json.

capabilities.label: Dev flow
capabilities.description: Where your change stands, the checks it needs, closing it, landing it, debts and decision records.

tools.description: Where your checkout stands: branch, ahead/behind main, uncommitted files, the checks this change needs, what is still owed, and the next step. Call it first, and whenever you are unsure what to do next.
Run the checks your change needs (tests, lint, build as the project declares them), or the full gate with full=true. Waits up to 40 seconds; if still running it returns a run id for wait.

full.description: Run the full gate instead of the checks this change selects.

tools.description: Close your change when the work is committed: runs its checks (reusing passes on the same content), applies the project's rules, and lists what is still owed before landing (handoff note, changelog fragment, index row). Use strict=true right before landing.

strict.description: Fail when something is still owed.

tools.description: Land your closed change on main: with the project's own land command, or by asking COGNIX[WS]'s Merge where the workspace lets agents merge (the same checks run first). Where the person merges, it says the change waits for them.
Keep waiting for a check, close or land that answered 'still running', by its run id.
Record a debt in docs/handoff/open/<topic>.md, or mark one paid with pay=true (never delete a debt line). The file is written for you to commit.

topic.description: Topic file name: lower-case letters, digits, dashes.

text.description: The debt, one sentence; with pay=true, the start of the open item.

note.description: With pay=true: how it was paid.

tools.description: Seed a decision record for a change that crosses a boundary (protocol, persistence, security model, process), with the next number free across every worktree. Fill its Boundary line first.

name.description: Short file name: lower-case letters, digits, dashes.

tools.description: Read one of the Dev flow's guides when your CLI did not load it as a skill.
